case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests repeatedly praised the hotel's central location, attentive and friendly staff, excellent breakfast, cleanliness, and spacious, well-decorated rooms often with balconies or large bathrooms. Reviewers also mentioned tasteful decor and a homely atmosphere. Negative comments were less frequent and included issues such as lack of a wardrobe, air-conditioning concerns, pillow comfort, and an untidy outside/garden area; several reviews reported no negatives.
